'''Sithlord119 Bounty Sucm & Villany''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Sithlord119]]
* '''Published:''' 3 May 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jabba's Palace|JP-D-tatooinejabbaspalace.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Jabba's Palace
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Tatooine Jabba's Palace Sithlord1.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A deck that is all about that presious Bounty and guess what our favorite red-faced double bladed saber wileding Villian just may make a surprise appearance...
